_comment: THE listing copy, for BOTH stores (`docs/deployment.md`, "Listing metadata"). scripts/resolve-deployment.py renders
it into App Store Connect's files (build/metadata/app-info, build/metadata/version/current) and Google Play's
Placeholders: {{domain}} is the resolved deployment's domain; any other {{word}} is looked up in `words`, which
gives each store its own wording (an unknown word, or one missing for a store, fails the render). None is used
today: the copy says “gallery” on both stores (metadata/messaging.md). `apple` and `play` hold the fields only
one store has. Limits are checked in ci.yml's `metadata` gate: Play's title <=30,
shortDescription <=80, description <=4000; Apple's by `asc metadata validate`.
name: SnapSync Photos
description:
Every photo, in your gallery.

Create an event for a day out, a party or a holiday. Your family and friends just join, and from then on every photo anyone takes arrives in your gallery, while you're still together.

Just join
No account, no sign-up, no password. Scan the QR code or tap the link, and you're in. Even someone who joins late gets every photo from the event.

Every photo, in your gallery
The group's photos land in the gallery you already use, next to your own, exactly as they were taken. Only photos taken during the event are shared; screenshots and photos saved from chats stay out.

For a day out, a party or a holiday
Quick enough for a spontaneous afternoon, long enough for a two-week holiday.
